aboutGame.title: Was ist Sovereign Tower?
paragraphs: Sovereign Tower is a Geschichte-rich medieval Verwaltung RPG where Spieler become the ruler of a magical Turm. You recruit unique knights, assign quests, and make Entscheidungen that shape your Königreich.

The game combines Königreich Verwaltung, character relationships, and time manipulation mechanics. Players can rewrite decisions, discover secrets, and create different outcomes through multiple timelines.

faq.description: Schnelle Antworten to the most common questions about Sovereign Tower.

items.question: Was ist Sovereign Tower?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower is a medieval Verwaltung RPG about ruling a magical Turm, recruiting knights, assigning quests, and shaping Königreich outcomes through Geschichte Entscheidungen.

items.question: What should beginners do first in Sovereign Tower?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower beginners should learn how the Sovereign role works, recruit early knights, understand quest assignments, and watch how each decision changes Königreich progress.

items.question: How do knights work in Sovereign Tower?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower knights are recruited characters who support Königreich quests, Geschichte events, and Round Table decisions. Managing their roles and relationships is central to progression.

items.question: How do quests affect Sovereign Tower?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower quests drive Geschichte progression, Königreich Verwaltung, and character outcomes. Choices made during quests can open different paths and reveal new events.

items.question: Does Sovereign Tower have Zeitrücklauf mechanics?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower uses Zeitrücklauf Entscheidungen so Spieler can revisit decisions, use knowledge from previous outcomes, and pursue stronger Königreich results across timelines.

items.question: Where can Spieler get Sovereign Tower?
items.answer: Sovereign Tower is verfügbar on Steam for PC, with official game information and updates published through the Steam page and WILD WITS GAMES channels.
